skill.description: 在用户明确确认后，定位唯一可乐瓶，生成动作，执行抓取放置，并验证结果。

ownership.language: 语音或文字输入、意图理解、Skill 选择、参数填充、确认卡片
ownership.vision: 唯一可乐目标检测、mask、帧新鲜度、执行前授权和执行后证据
ownership.policy: 输出 fixed waypoint execution plan，或输出经 adapter 转换的 LeRobot ACT action chunk
ownership.robot: 复用现有 Startouch JSON-lines bridge、示教点、反馈校验、安全停止和互斥控制
ownership.orchestrator: 状态机、超时、重试、trace、跨服务调用和最终结果

stateMachine.failureRule: rejected or expired candidates end without calling Vision, Policy or Robot
no Coke, ambiguous Coke, non-Coke or stale frame must reject motion
missing checkpoint, incompatible startouch-j1-j6-rad-gripper-v1 action space or invalid execution plan blocks execution
safety failure, stale state, CAN fault or concurrent motion causes safe stop
uncertain evidence must stay uncertain and must not be upgraded to success
simulate and dry-run flows may succeed as integration demos but may not claim verified real success

safetyInvariants: confirmation must reference the same candidateId and traceId
only one authorized coke_bottle target may proceed
a detector must never fall back to the highest-confidence non-Coke object
speedScale must be greater than zero and no more than 0.15
simulate and dry-run outcomes must be clearly labelled
verified real success requires hardware feedback and visual verification
all stages preserve traceId and record their messageId/replyTo chain
fixed_waypoint_a_to_b requires pick_zone_a as source and drop_zone_b as destination
the existing home_transit_ab second half must not run because it moves the bottle from B back to A

existingRobotFoundation.evidenceLevel: GitHub code and documentation inspected; hardware was not revalidated during this contract update

fixedWaypointReuse.reason: the remaining existing states pick the bottle at B and return it to A

aiContinuationRules: Read contracts/README_CN.md and contracts/schema.json before editing an integration module.
Do not modify the contract merely to fit one module; write a small adapter first.
Validate every inbound and outbound message.
Return service.error rather than silently dropping or guessing missing fields.
Keep model-specific tensors, images and checkpoints behind references; do not embed large binary data in JSON.
Do not connect Language directly to robot execution.
Use the existing Startouch bridge instead of creating a second CAN or SDK owner.
Do not run the complete existing home_transit_ab workflow for this one-way Skill.
Do not enable real motion while implementing or testing the contract.
